params.body:
## Summary

Two finishing touches on the vehicle list, following the Stocklist dealer sites.

- **Sticky filter panel.** On wide screens the panel stays in view while the list scrolls (`lg:sticky lg:top-6`). When the panel is taller than the viewport it scrolls within itself, with a thin scrollbar, so the lower filters stay reachable.
- **Skeleton cards while loading.** Changing a filter or category replaces the cards with grey placeholders of the same dimensions (6 to 12, matching what was on screen); loading the next page appends one placeholder per card that is on its way. The list no longer fades and the layout does not jump. The placeholder is a `<template>` in the view, cloned by the script; `aria-busy` marks the results while a request runs, and the pulse animation respects reduced motion.

Checked in a headless browser on the local stock: the panel sits at 24 px after scrolling, 12 placeholders during a brand filter, 24 during the next page, none left afterwards, no script errors.

## After merge

Deploy; `npm run build` is part of the Forge deploy script.
